trans-unit.source: Some good news for once: Prince Laird is free.
trans-unit.target: Some good news for once: Prince Laird is free.

trans-unit.source: Thanks to our efforts in saving him, we have earned permission to explore the Moria Mine.

trans-unit.source: Not to mention, we got the incredible spear, Gungnir.

trans-unit.source: Hey, is it really so great?

trans-unit.source: Sure, it's called “The Divine Spear,” after all.
